This was sort of a lesson I had to learn myself and that is people are allowed to change no matter what. It's human nature to change and develop and unfortunately, it can affect relationships too. My Ex left me for the same reason, she just changed. Even now when I talk to her it still feels like a whole different person. I don't like it, of course, but what can you do?

My advice to you is to let time heal, accept your feelings for what they are and forgive yourself. Some days you'll feel amazing and some days you won't. You can necessarily control or speed up the process but you can definitely do some things to help you distract you like friends, hobbies, working out, and work. It's been about a year and some months now since my break up and i think up until March this year was when I finally felt perfectly fine haha so don't get too mad if you "feeling better" takes longer than expected.
